title: Cutover pocket scratchpad
content:
Personal pocket scratchpad for today's cutover - quick, messy, single-source for me. Not a runbook; this is what I need to keep in my head and to ping people with.

Top-level goals:
- Push 2026.03.12-prod image to staging then prod.
- Merge hotfix for token-encoding regression (PR #1127) and backport to 2026.02.x branch.
- Ensure metrics dashboards show no spike in 95p latency and request errors stay <0.5%.

Pre-cutover checklist (T-2h -> T-15m):
- T-120m: final CI green, smoke tests pass on canary. (ran smoke-suite.sh at 09:05, ok)
- T-90m: announce to #releng-cutover & #oncall-sre: "cutover window 11:30-12:00 UTC; expect brief degradations". TODO: @Maya to post.
- T-60m: create canary with 5% traffic to new image. verify tracing spans show new kernel selection.
- T-30m: run quick load test (locust) for 5 minutes, target 20 rps per instance. Capture baseline.
- T-15m: freeze merges, set maintenance page flag (feature-flags/maintenance = true).
- T-5m: confirm DB migration lock will be short; if >10s pause rollout. VERIFY: @Ethan to confirm lock window with DB team.

Immediate cutover TODOs (execution):
- Promote canary -> 25% -> 60% -> 100% with 5m observation at each step.
- Watchpoints: token-encoder errors, kv-cache miss rate, RTX mem pressure.
- If 95p latency > SLO or error rate >0.5%: rollback to previous image (image: 2026.02.18-release) and open incident.
- If rollout fails at any step, set traffic-split back to previous percentage and pause.

Backports / cherry-picks to keep handy:
- PR #1127 (token encoding): must land on 2026.02.x. Cherry-pick commit: c3f7a2d. Test: unit-encoding-test, integration-encoder.
- PR #1133 (kv-cache path fix): can be deferred if canary ok but prefer backport. Commit b8e41fa.
- Hotpatch for quantization path (if crash observed): manual build + tag hotpatch/quant-20260312.

Quick commands I will run (notes to self):
- smoke suite: ./scripts/smoke-suite.sh --env=canary | tee smoke-canary.log
- create canary: infractl rollout create --image=registry/redwood/infra:2026.03.12-canary --traffic=5
- promote step: infractl rollout promote --id=<rollout-id> --to=25
- rollback: infractl rollout rollback --to-image=registry/redwood/infra:2026.02.18-release
- db migration status: psql -h redwood-db -c "select pid, state, query_start, query from pg_stat_activity where query like '%ALTER TABLE%';"

Monitoring and dashboards to watch:
- /dashboards/serving/latency-overview (95p token-gen per model)
- /dashboards/serving/errors (5m rate, grouped by error.code)
- /dashboards/infra/gpu-util (node-level mem + temp)
- Sentry: project=serving-runtime, search for regressions since 11:00 UTC

Comms snippets (copy-paste):
- Pre-cutover: "Heads-up: starting scheduled cutover for infra image 2026.03.12 at 11:30 UTC. Expect short bursts of elevated latency while canary promotes. Contact @oncall if you see >0.5% errors."
- Success update: "Cutover complete. 100% traffic on 2026.03.12 image; no regression observed in 95p latency or error rate after 30m. Closing window."
- Rollback alert: "Rolled back cutover to 2026.02.18-release at T+X due to elevated 95p latency (>SLO). Incident filed: INC-REL-20260312-01"

Rollforward/rollback decision tree (shorthand):
- small blip in latency (<10% above baseline) & errors stable -> continue promote, monitor 10m
- latency spike sustained (>2 sampling windows) or errors >0.5% -> rollback to previous image and page SRE lead
- memory OOMs on GPU nodes -> immediate rollback + cordon affected nodes + page infra

Known unknowns / open questions:
- Confirm whether private deployments will receive the same image today (probably no; separate pipeline). Check with @Sam (private-deployments).
- Will the dedicated region us-west-2 be included? Ops ticket said yes but need final confirm.
- Migration lock duration estimate from DB team (Ethan follow-up).

Personal reminders (don't forget):
- Coffee before T-30m.
- Keep my phone on silent but notifications for #oncall-sre enabled.
- If I need to step away, set status in Slack: "brief break - monitoring" and handoff to Maya.

Post-cutover quick retro notes (to fill after):
- Time to full promote: __
- Any regression: __
- Follow-ups: list of PRs to clean up, docs to update (deploy notes), metric alerts adjusted

Scratchy log (running notes) - for my brain: 
- 09:02 - pulled branch, ran local lint, unit tests ok
- 09:18 - created canary image tag 2026.03.12-canary
- 09:46 - smoke tests passed on canary (latency slightly lower than baseline)
- 10:05 - final CI green, adding hold until 11:30

End of scratchpad. Keep this ephemeral; will formalize a runbook if anything goes sideways.
